new_candidates.body:
When a JTC action gets aborted because a new trajectory comes in, the trajectory result is `INVALID GOAL`. That doesn't seem to be meaningful feedback. As a user I would expect `INVALID GOAL` if the goal I sent contains something illegal. However, I think in that case we reject the goal already.

I would suggest to add a new error code to `ctrl_msgs/action/FollowJointTrajectory.action` e.g. `MOTION_REPLACED` or `ABORTED_BY_NEW_TRAJECTORY` or even a more generic one `UNSUCCESSFUL` or such.

I'm happy to implement this, once a decision has been made.
new_candidates.title: [JTC] Overwriting a goal results in INVALID GOAL
